{{Quote|You needn't have had her shot, Antilles.''"<br />"''Wouldn't do to have witnesses, would it? We could have killed her, but unnecessary bloodshed is not something we revel in. In fact, we don't like it at all.|Sair Yonka and Wedge Antilles, regarding Aellyn Jandi|<ref name="bw" />}}
'''Aellyn Jandi''' was [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. She became the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Riit Jandi]], a man forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] her senior. She embarked upon an affair with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sair Yonka]], who was her childhood friend.<ref name="bw" />
